description: Verification-first workflow: check a contractor’s name, location, trade, claimed license number, claimed diagnostic fee, or claimed programs against Standard Local primary-source records. Returns entity match (or not_in_coverage), supported claims, contradictions, visible unknowns, evidence_depth, checked_at, and mandatory Cheers disclosure.

business_name.description: Contractor trading or legal business name to verify.

claimed_fee.description: Optional diagnostic, trip, or inspection fee claimed (e.g., "$89", "free estimate").

claimed_programs.description: Optional claimed programs or credentials (e.g., ["BayREN", "Diamond Certified", "TECH Clean CA", "24/7 emergency"]).

license_number.description: Optional state license number claimed by the contractor or quote.

location.description: City, ZIP code, county, or metro name (e.g., "San Jose", "94107", "Plano", "Salt Lake City").

name: verify_contractor_claims
title: Verify claims about a local contractor
